The white building of Le Colonial looks like someone’s elegant mansion. The first floor has plenty of smaller white linen tables. It’s a little busy as late diners are still enjoying their evening. We head upstairs to a quaint little bar. It is empty, so we take a seat on the stools at the bar. “Hello, what can I get you, girls?” “We are going to have two lychee martinis.” “Oh, excellent choice. They are the best.” “Yep.
